name: Form
description: Complete application form: title and description, a list of fields (FormField), an acceptance checkbox and a submit button. It shows the general error, the submission in progress or the confirmation in the same place, without changing page.

dos: Short title that says what the form asks for: "Let's talk about your project", not "Contact form".
Put only FormField and, if needed, an acceptance Checkbox in the fields. A new field is a FormField with its visible label.
Use `variant="card"` (default) when the form sits on the page. Use `plain` when it is already inside a card or a panel with its own background.
Use `state="error"` when submission fails or there are empty fields. Mark the field with FormField `error` and let the banner say how many need review.
Use `state="submitting"` while submitting, and `state="success"` once sent. On success, the form is replaced by the confirmation message.

donts.case: A single-question or single-button form, without a title
donts.why: Form renders a header, error banner and confirmation. For a single field they are unnecessary and take up space.

donts.useInstead: Several views, with Tabs or custom steps
donts.why: Form has a single submission state. A step flow needs its own progress control.

donts.case: Actions that do not submit (cancel, back, delete)
donts.useInstead: Button with variant="ghost" or "outline" outside the Form
donts.why: The Form has only one submit button (solid, accent). Another action with the same weight makes it unclear what happens on press.

donts.case: Validating in the Form what the fields should validate
donts.why: Form shows the general state; each FormField decides whether its value is valid. Mixing the two leaves errors without a message.

related.difference: Each field in the form is a FormField with label, control and message.
Acceptance checkbox for the privacy policy.
Success confirmation (success) in the success state.
Icon of the error banner and of the checkbox message.

props.name: variant
props.description: Container appearance. card = neutral.1 background, neutral-alpha.6 border and 8 px radius with 32 px padding; plain = no background, no border and no padding. In Figma, the component set default is card.

props.name: showDescription
props.description: If true, shows the description below the title.

props.name: state
props.description: Submission state. default = fields and button active. error = general error banner, unchecked checkbox and checkbox message; the button stays active. submitting = button disabled, fields unchanged. success = fields, checkbox, button and banner are hidden, and the confirmation appears. In Figma, it is the state property.

controlled.name: error
controlled.description: Shows the "Revisa los campos marcados." banner, the error icon and the checkbox message. The banner is announced to the screen reader when it appears.

controlled.name: submitting
controlled.description: The submit button is disabled (state=disable in Figma). The fields stay editable in Figma; see needsReview.
controlled.aria: disabled (native HTML attribute) on the submit button

controlled.name: success
controlled.description: Replaces the fields and the button with the confirmation. The message is announced to the screen reader.

root.description: Root element. Column with header, error banner, fields, actions or confirmation. Its appearance is given by variant.

header.description: Header: title and description. Column with 4 px gap.

title.description: Form title. Fixed text "Hablemos de tu proyecto" in Figma: not a property. Proposal: h2, because the level depends on the page.

description.description: Description below the title. Fixed text "Déjanos tus datos y te escribimos en 24 h." in Figma. Only with showDescription=true.

formError.description: General error banner: 16 px info icon and text "Revisa los campos marcados.". Only with state=error. error-alpha.3 background at 8 %.

formErrorIcon.description: 16 px info icon of the banner.

fields.description: List of fields and the privacy checkbox. Column with 16 px gap. Hidden in success.

privacy.description: Acceptance checkbox for the privacy policy. Checked in default, submitting and success; unchecked in error. Fixed text "Acepto la política de privacidad" in Figma.

privacyError.description: Checkbox message: 14 px info icon and text "Acepta la política para continuar.". Only with state=error.

privacyErrorIcon.description: 14 px info icon of the checkbox message.

actions.description: Actions group: the submit button, aligned right and at the full width of the group. Hidden in success.

successMessage.description: Submission confirmation: Badge success (soft, size 2) and the text "Gracias. Te escribiremos pronto.". Only with state=success.

successBadge.description: Confirmation badge: variant soft, color success, size 2.

height.note: Height of the Figma example in the default state (502 px, card). Depends on the fields and the state; it is not fixed.

width.note: Figma defines a fixed 400 px. Decide whether in the application it should be fill.

autoLayout.gap: spacing.5 (24 px) between header, banner, fields and actions. In plain, the same.

formErrorLayout.gap: spacing.2 (8 px); spacing.3 (12 px) padding on all four sides

events.name: onSubmit
events.trigger: Submit the form (submit button or Enter in a field). Not in Figma: needed for the submission to take effect.

a11y.role: form, only with an accessible name (aria-labelledby points to the title)
a11y.name: The title (title) via aria-labelledby. Without a visible title, aria-label is mandatory.
keyboard: Tab — moves through the fields, the checkbox and the button in order
Space — checks or unchecks the checkbox
Enter — in a field, submits the form (proposal)
a11y.focusIndicator: Inherited by FormField, Checkbox and Button from their contracts. The Form adds no ring of its own.
a11y.minTarget: Submit button 32 px tall. Checkbox 16 px visible: its clickable area must include the label (≥ 24 × 24 px, WCAG 2.5.8).
a11y.contrastNote: neutral.12 and neutral.11 text on neutral.1 (card). Error text colors.semantic.error.11 on error-alpha.3 at 8 % and on the background. Not measured in Figma.
wcag: 1.4.1 Use of Color (the error carries an icon and text)

label.voice: Friendly and direct, informal second person (tú). Fixed Figma texts: title "Hablemos de tu proyecto", description "Déjanos tus datos y te escribimos en 24 h.", error "Revisa los campos marcados.", checkbox "Acepto la política de privacidad", button "Enviar" and confirmation "Gracias. Te escribiremos pronto.".

behavior.overflow: wrap: the description, banner and messages wrap within the form width.

errorMessage.note: Fixed text "Revisa los campos marcados." in Figma. Validation is done by each FormField; Form only shows the state.

form.note: Form neither validates nor submits by itself: submission is handled by onSubmit. The state (error, submitting, success) is decided by whoever uses the component.

i18n.rtl: The submit button is aligned right (MAX) in LTR; in RTL it aligns left. The button arrow must flip in RTL.
i18n.textExpansion: With text 30-40 % longer, the title and messages wrap. The fixed 400 px width makes the actions row take less space; the button may not fit next to other text.

cases: renders a form with header, fields and actions, with the spacing and text-style tokens from the table
variant=card applies neutral.1 background, neutral-alpha.6 border, 8 px radius and 32 px padding; plain applies none
state=error shows the banner with role=alert and the checkbox message; the checkbox is left unchecked
state=submitting disables the submit button and does not hide the fields
state=success hides fields, actions and the banner, and shows the confirmation with role=status
the title is associated with the form via aria-labelledby
the privacy checkbox and the button accept only Checkbox and Button in the corresponding slot
onSubmit does not fire in submitting or success

needsReview: The component set has 8 variants: variant (card, plain) × state (default, error, submitting, success). All read. The card and plain variants have the same structure; only the container changes (background, border, radius, padding).
Props read: variant (VARIANT), showDescription (BOOLEAN) and state (VARIANT). None of the three has values missing from the contract.

Fixed texts in Figma, with no property: title, description, error banner, checkbox, "Enviar" button and confirmation. As in FormField, no text props have been added. Question: add them in Figma or approve them in code?

Inconsistency between contracts: the Figma "Comentario" field uses a TextArea as its control, and FormField.contract.json only accepts TextField. If the TextArea is valid, FormField must accept it (contract change with a version bump). FormField has not been touched.

Fields with text override: the labels "Nombre", "Correo electrónico" and "Comentario", the placeholders and the help texts are FormField instance overrides, not Form properties. The three fields are fixed in Figma: there is no way to change them from the Form.

Error state in Figma: only the email field goes to error (FormField state=error). The other two do not change. In the contract, error is a state of the Form, not of each field: decide how the error is passed on to each FormField.

Error state: the privacy checkbox becomes unchecked (status=unchecked). Figma does not say what unchecks it: the form's own error or a checkbox rule. The contract describes it as error-state behavior; confirm.

Submitting state: the button goes to state=disable (disabled), without the loading spinner. Figma does not use loading. Decision: disabled, no spinner. If a spinner is wanted, use Button loading and update Figma.
Submitting state: the fields do not change in Figma (they keep their normal state). Decision: do not block them in submitting; confirm.
Success state: fields, actions and the banner are hidden; the confirmation is shown (Badge success, soft, size 2, 14 px text in text-style.2.regular). The header stays visible.
Submit button: Button variant=solid, color=accent, size=2 with iconEnd arrow-right (16 px). Fixed in Figma. The "Enviar" label and the arrow are instance overrides.
Width: 400 px FIXED in the component set. Proposal: width fixed by default; if in the application it must fill the container, change to fill.
Height 502 px in default: result of summing the parts (header 52 px, fields 304 px and button 32 px plus 24 px gaps). No token.

Measurements with no variable: submit button height (32 px, matches tokens.space.button-height-2 by value), 16 and 14 px icons (Icon accepts '14' and '16'), card padding 32 px = spacing.6 (bound), gap 24 = spacing.5 (bound), 16 = spacing.4 (bound).
Card stroke: neutral-alpha.6 with 0.15 opacity on the stroke itself, as in Navbar. The color token is bound; the opacity has no token and the stroke position was not read. Verify by hand.
Error banner: colors.semantic.error-alpha.3 background with 0.08 opacity on the fill itself. The opacity has no token and is documented as a Figma value. Verify by hand.

Checkbox: variant surface, size 2, highContrast false, status checked; its label is an instance override. Its contract uses checked as a boolean; in the Form the checkbox is checked in all states except error.

Content, guidance, a11y (role=alert on the banner, role=status on the confirmation, aria-labelledby on the form), testing, events (onSubmit) and the form block: written as a draft. They do not come from Figma. Own decisions: form as root element, h2 for the title, Enter submits, and onSubmit blocked in submitting and success.
Contrast not measured. Figma defines no disabled state for the whole Form nor visible focus.
governance: null, same as Button. Component owners still need to be defined.
